article.title: Acusativo: masculino animado
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: In masculine consonant-declension nouns, animate accusative singular matches genitive while inanimate accusative singular matches nominative.
Я знаю этого профессора has an animate accusative form identical to genitive; the paired inanimate form Я знаю этот ресторан matches nominative.
Cornell’s grammar directly gives Я знаю этого профессора and Я знаю этот ресторан as the contrastive pair.
The cited rule is limited to singular masculine consonant-declension nouns.

locator.description: Cornell, “Acc. Sg. and Plur. endings and animacy,” lines 0–2 and 7–9: singular masculine rule and exact paired examples.
